::: {.mx-lg-3}
[Hi, my name is Mel --- ]{.text-serif .text-muted .me-2 style="font-size:2em;"} I am an [Applied Economist]{.mark} turned [Geospatial Data Scientist]{.mark} (yes, around that time when global model simulations required distributed loads) -- I am passionate about ZERO nonsense, equitable and sustainable policy making that truly empowers everyone's life in full respect of planetary boundaries.

As a [consultant]{.mark}, [designer]{.mark}, and [instructor]{.mark}, I specialize in helping research teams and businesses effectively harness data, build  models, and communicate insights through engaging stories and visuals

I code mostly in [R]{.mark}, [Python]{.mark}, [JavaScript]{.mark} and [D3.js]{.mark}. Check out my full bio for contact details.
:::

# Services

I provide a variety of services catered to geospatial and remote sensing data:

::: {.column-page .d-md-flex .flex-row .gap-3}

::: {.bg-secondary-subtle .px-2}

### Geospatial and Remote Sensing Analysis

Machine learning model development and inference for geospatial applications

I offer services in developing predictive models for geospatial applications. Including, but not limited to, retrieval models for multi- and hyperspectral satellite and airborne sensors, as well as multivariate prediction models for ecosystem assessment and climate projections.
:::

::: {.bg-secondary-subtle .px-2}

### Software Development

Software development, data pipelines & cloud infrastructure for scalable geo-applications. Tailored software development and implementation services for the efficient processing and analysis of large-scale geospatial and remote sensing datasets.

:::

::: {.bg-secondary-subtle .px-2}

### Data Visualization

Interactive visualization solutions.
:::

:::
